examples.source: Steady-state peak, 1,000 mg over 1 h every 12 h, ke 0.1/h, V 50 L: Cmax,ss = C_end / (1 - e^(-ke tau)) = 27.2358 mg/L
Sawchuk-Zaske: steady-state peak 1 h after the end of infusion and trough 0.5 h before the next dose, same interval: ke = ln(Cpeak/Ctrough)/(9.5 h) = 0.1/h
Steady-state AUC over one interval = dose / CL = 1000 / (0.1 * 50) = 200 mg h/L (AUC24 = 400 at every 12 h)
Steady-state AUC over one interval, 1,750 mg over 2 h every 8 h, ke 0.25/h, V 40 L: 1750 / 10 = 175 mg h/L
Hand-worked: 1,000 mg over 1 h, CL 0.5 L/h, V 50 L, dialysis 3 to 7 h at 120 mL/min (7.2 L/h); C(10 h) = [R/k0 (1 - e^-k0)] e^-2k0 e^-4k1 e^-3k0 / V with k0 = 0.5/50, k1 = 7.7/50 = 10.2240 mg/L
AUC from 0 to 2,000 h of one 1,000 mg infusion over 1 h, CL 0.5 L/h, V 50 L, no dialysis = dose/CL minus the tail beyond 2,000 h, 2000 - A(2000 h)/(V k) = 1999.9999959 mg h/L
